ctx.x: Oh, I can't think of all those folks' names. Percy Mayberry (PHONETIC), Percy Mayfield (PHONETIC) and whoever was the blues things at that time. They had a whole lot of people. Names sometimes escape me, of things that I just did one ortwo times. But you (unintelligible) a lot of unknown people were in the rhythm and blues deals, just the same as they have them now in the rock and roll field. Little Miss Cornshucks --
